name: codemap-ai
description: Explore TypeScript and JavaScript source dependencies as an interactive graph.

codemap.ai.model.description: Model ID provided through VS Code Language Model API. Use CodeMap: Choose AI Model to select.

languageModelTools.name: codemap_get_architecture
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Workspace module overview, central files, entry candidates and static import cycles. Does not analyze runtime calls.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Workspace module overview, central files, entry candidates and static import cycles. Does not analyze runtime calls.

languageModelTools.name: codemap_get_dependencies
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Dependencies, dependents, symbols, import source positions and outside graph dependencies of an exact file in CodeMap.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Dependencies, dependents, symbols, import source positions and outside graph dependencies of an exact file in CodeMap.

path.description: Exact workspace-relative path from the CodeMap graph.

languageModelTools.name: codemap_get_selected_context
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the latest explicitly reviewed CodeMap Context preview, including source and annotations. User must select files and click Preview context first. Never expands to other files.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the latest explicitly reviewed CodeMap Context preview, including source and annotations. User must select files and click Preview context first. Never expands to other files.

languageModelTools.name: codemap_get_impact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Static transitive dependents and import routes for an existing CodeMap file; not runtime behavior.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Static transitive dependents and import routes for an existing CodeMap file; not runtime behavior.

path.description: Exact workspace-relative path from the CodeMap graph.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile
scripts.test:ai:live: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && node scripts/live-model-smoke.mjs
